import sys
import re

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    if len(data) > 1:
        str_line = data[1]
    else:
        str_line = ''
    if n <= 0:
        print("0 0")
        return
    s = str_line[:n]
    # Split on delimiters, keeping them as separate tokens
    tokens = [t for t in re.split(r'([_()])', s) if t != '']
    inside = False
    cur_len = 0
    inside_words = 0
    max_len = 0
    for token in tokens:
        if token in ('_', '(', ')'):
            if cur_len > 0:
                if inside:
                    inside_words += 1
                else:
                    if cur_len > max_len:
                        max_len = cur_len
                cur_len = 0
            if token == '(':
                inside = True
            elif token == ')':
                inside = False
            # underscore does nothing else
        else:
            cur_len += len(token)
    if cur_len > 0:
        if inside:
            inside_words += 1
        else:
            if cur_len > max_len:
                max_len = cur_len
    print(f"{max_len} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
